python.package: Core validation library - BaseModel, Field, ConfigDict
Web framework - DTOs used for request/response

constraints.constraint: Follow Pydantic BaseModel with Field validation pattern per tech spec Section 4.2
Use ConfigDict(populate_by_name=True) for camelCase API aliases if needed
uOpeMod field: ge=1, le=7 (operation mode range)
Output position fields (yDam, yVal): ge=0, le=1 (normalized 0-1)
All fields must have description and json_schema_extra with example for OpenAPI
DTOs in src/dto/, tests in tests/unit/
Class names: PascalCase (ReheatInputs), fields: matching FMU names (TZon, VDis_flow)

interface.name: ReheatParameters
interface.signature: class ReheatParameters(BaseModel): VCooMax: float, VHeaMax: float, VMin: float

interface.name: ReheatInputs
interface.signature: class ReheatInputs(BaseModel): TZon: float, TCooSet: float, THeaSet: float, TDis: float, VDis_flow: float, TSup: float, TSupSet: float, u1Fan: bool, uOpeMod: int

interface.name: ReheatOutputs
interface.signature: class ReheatOutputs(BaseModel): yDam: float, yVal: float, VSet_flow: float

interface.name: CreateInstanceRequest
interface.signature: class CreateInstanceRequest(BaseModel): instance_id: str, parameters: ReheatParameters | None = None

interface.name: StepRequest
interface.signature: class StepRequest(BaseModel): step_size: float, inputs: ReheatInputs

tests.standards: TDD workflow: write failing tests first, implement DTOs to pass. Use pytest with pytest-asyncio. Test edge cases including boundary values (250K, 350K), invalid types, missing required fields, and extra fields. Follow naming convention test_*.py.
